_comment: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE of the disregarded-warning register. The live register is a private record at monitor/private/disregarded-warnings.json (CW_DISREGARDED_WARNINGS overrides; absent means nothing has been set aside). Append-only: never delete a record. Identity is {source, code, subject}: source = the tool that warned, code = the kind of warning, subject = the place (repo, area, file or check), never a line number. A later warning with the same identity is reported as RETURNED, with the latest set-aside beside it. Write through bin/disregard.mjs.

disregarded.subject: example/README.md
disregarded.why: Synthetic example: the module is being rewritten this cycle and the doc is re-verified when it lands.
